NAD-dependent HMS oxidation and downstream activities occur in extracts; no hydrolase activity is detected under tested growth/assay conditions. This is not a genomic absence claim.
HMS dehydrogenase was enriched17-fold,0.6%yield and still showed multiple protein bands; do not call it homogeneous.

4OT single bands,51kDa gel filtration and12kDa SDS support inferred tetramer. Source51kDa differs from native48kDa calculated4×12; retain measurement versus inference.
4OT remaining activity:1mMMn45%,3.3mMMg63%,33mMCa72%,1mMZn55%,40mMK46%;1mMiodoacetate5%,pCMB72%,Tiron54%. Values27.2/19.1% nearby refer to mt2 comparator, not10d.
4OT inhibitors include alpha-ketovalerate,2oxopent4enoate,oxaloacetate;2oxobutyrate,2oxoglutarate,4methyl2oxovalerate did not inhibit. None of11tested metals was required.
4OD/hydratase copurify,470kDa apparent native mass,29/27kDa bands,1:1molar ratio. Total assembly stoichiometry is unresolved; minor bands remain.
The27kDa hydratase has80%Nterminal identity to anotherP.putida sequence;29kDa decarboxylase has no significant match in the historical search. Do not mint exact current sequence identity.
Both10d activities requireMg in these preparations.4OD remaining activities at1mM:Fe23%,Mn9%,ferricyanide36%,Co47%,iodoacetate64%,pCMB54%,NEM58%,Tiron59%;hydratase fully inhibited by1mMHg.

Derivatized products and retention/mass spectra support listed metabolites. Extraction/derivatization of a keto product cannot exclude an initial enzymatic enol or establish exact transient2Z geometry.
Spontaneous enol/keto equilibrium is reached after15min in100mMphosphate pH7; purified4OT accelerates spectral conversion. This differs fromJS45 and1971 preparation/conditions.
Pyruvate is directly identified; acetaldehyde is drawn downstream without a separately purified aldolase orCoA-acylating endpoint assay in this study.
